### Connected knowledge

Docs, projects, tasks, chats, decisions, contacts, and meetings that
build on each other, so you never start from scratch.

Allhands prepSkill

Description

Prepare the agenda and pre-read for the all-hands.

Pull last week's milestones from product, sales, and ops. Surface the
open questions and any decisions the team still needs to make. Group by
area, keep each bullet to one line.

CopywriterAgent

Description

Edit drafts in the house voice.

Tighten the lede. Vary sentence length. Cut filler. Match the tone we
use across the site. Be concise, direct, never marketing-y. Flag any
claim that needs a source.

Executive BriefSkill

Description

Distill the past week into a leadership update.

Lead with the headline. Three highlights, two risks, and the decisions
still open. Keep it under 150 words. Pull metrics from the dashboard and
link the source for each.

### Customizable AI

Easy to configure agents and skills with the memory and tools to do real
work, without being micro-managed.
